# Northwind Telecom — Porting your number in

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## What porting is

Mobile number portability moves a number from one operator to another while keeping the number. The
number, not the SIM, moves; you get a new Northwind SIM and your old operator's SIM stops working.

## Before you start

The number must have been active with the current operator for at least 90 days, must have no
outstanding bill, and must not be under an active contract lock-in. A postpaid number with a bill
generated but not yet due can still be ported; a number with an overdue bill cannot.

## Getting the porting code

Send `PORT` followed by a space and your number to 1900 from the number you are porting. The current
operator replies with an eight-character Unique Porting Code. The code is valid for 15 days in most
circles and 30 days in Jammu and Kashmir, Assam and the North East.

## Placing the request

Give the porting code with your Northwind application, along with the same identity and address
documents any new connection needs. The request is submitted to the clearing house the same day.

## How long it takes

Three working days within the same circle and five working days between circles. The clearing house
sets a porting window, usually between 01:00 and 05:00, and you are told the date the day before.

## What happens in the window

The old connection stops and the new SIM starts, typically within two hours. Keep the new SIM in the
handset overnight so it registers as soon as the window opens. Incoming calls may fail for a few
minutes at the moment of the switch.

## If a request is rejected

The clearing house states a reason, most often an outstanding bill, a code that has expired, or a
mismatch between the name on the number and the name on the application. A rejected request can be
placed again once the reason is fixed; a new porting code is needed if the old one has expired.

## Porting out

The same process in reverse, requested from the operator you are moving to. Northwind Telecom does
not delay a port-out; a request is cleared unless an overdue bill or an active lock-in blocks it.
